assumptions: Starting capital ₹35,000; whole shares; no leverage.
Signals on the close, bought at the next open; skipped if the open gaps more than 1% above.
Costs 0.15% + slippage 0.05% per side, plus ₹16 per sale.
Prices adjusted for splits and bonuses; delisted stocks included (no survivorship bias).
Fundamentals, results dates and ASM/GSM lists are NOT applied – no point-in-time history is freely available. Live picks get these extra filters, so live results may differ.
Settings are fixed, textbook values – nothing was tuned to this data.

summary: Neither strategy cleared the bar on unseen years. Do not trade real money with them; keep paper trading, or put the money in a Nifty index fund until a version passes.
Robustness: 0 of 5 setting changes kept a profit factor ≥ 1.1.
